dedupe_keys.name: building dataset collection list of building energy and related datasets

description: building-dataset-collection is a small GitHub list of building-related datasets, organised in folders for building information, building energy, building occupancy, building images, fault detection and weather. The building energy folder, the only one with entries at the time of reading, lists 38 measured datasets with a short name, access terms, link, country and building types, for example the Irish BER research tool, Danish district heating typologies, the Australian Commercial Building Disclosure register, Singapore's building energy benchmarking report, NYC Local Law 84 disclosure, Gainesville utility consumption and Chicago energy usage. Coverage: mainly the United States, Europe, Australia and Singapore. Access: Markdown pages in the repository. Licence: none found; each linked dataset has its own terms. Caveats: the last commit was on 7 July 2024 and several folders are empty, so the list is incomplete and some links may be broken. Simulation uses are finding measured building energy data for benchmarking and model calibration. Related records: the England and Wales energy performance certificates record and other benchmarking disclosures in this catalogue.
